verdicts.reason: Both banners make the same mistakes. The SOLSTICE logo and wordmark are missing, the can and cream circle are shrunk to an unreadable thumbnail, and the 'NEW FLAVOR' badge is jammed against the left edge, partly cut off and colliding with the product circle. The subline is also illegibly small at 320×50. A spaces the headline and subline slightly better, while B pushes them against each other into a cramped block. That spacing is the only real difference between them.
